summary: Verified persistent Series Grouping bug fix. Frontend: /admin/supplier-products search 'Dolomite' renders all 23 Dolomite Onyx products under a SINGLE 'Dolomite Onyx Series · 23 products' group header — no splits, matches total row count (23 of 23). Backend: pytest 3/3 pass — POST /api/admin/series/bulk-assign writes all 5 fields (series, range_name, series_name, unique_name, original_series) and GET /api/supplier-sync/products includes series_name in each product payload. Name Sanity drawer regression passes (opens, lists 200 products). Local shadowing const getSeriesName is confirmed removed (grep clean — only the module-level def at line 137 remains).
critical_code_review_comments: SupplierProducts.js is 16,790 lines — long-term split into smaller modules (grouping helpers, bulk actions, filters, table rows) would help maintainability and prevent recurrence of shadowing bugs like this one.
React 'unique key prop' warning still fires in AdminDashboard render (pre-existing, unrelated to this fix).
handleBulkSetSeries uses native window.prompt — replacing with a shadcn Dialog with input validation would give a more consistent UX.
seed_data_creation: SERIES-TEST-1..6 supplier_products created and auto-deleted by pytest fixture teardown. No production data mutated (LP-3611 / LP-3631 were NOT touched — full backend contract already verified via fixtures).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Root cause was a locally-shadowed const getSeriesName inside SupplierProducts component that used a simpler algorithm than the top-level def, causing Canopy-imported rows with junk in original_series/unique_name to render as singleton groups. Fix removed the shadowing const, merged original_series check into the top-level getSeriesName (with junk-filter applied to it too), and made backend bulk-assign write all 5 series-carrying fields plus supplier-sync/products return series_name. All verified: pytest 3/3, Dolomite Onyx (23) shows as ONE group. Screenshot at .screenshots/dolomite_search.png confirms.
